method: Official Purdue GIS FID 777 polygon transformed to Indiana 2018 DSM raster CRS. Extracted valid 5-ft DSM cell centers inside polygon; separately sampled same-coordinate 2016-2020 Indiana bare-earth DEM ImageServer using a 6x6 interior WGS84 grid, then compared each terrain value to nearest DSM cell. The DTM at building points is interpolated bare earth, not observed under the building.

sources.vertical_units: DSM in U.S. survey feet; DEM identify returns feet (field service elevation units).

limits: 5-ft DSM cells mix roofs, equipment, edges, vegetation and artifacts; samples may fall on roof steps or eaves.
Bare-earth DEM values within footprint are interpolated terrain, not observed building ground.
Sampled raster cells are nearest-cell values, not a surface fit or roof-plane classification.
This 2018 surface predates the site/current 2023 image and later updates; it does not establish current roof features, wall height, story count, datum-tied parapet or ridge.
